report.summary: Not mergeable. The change adds no tests at all, against CLAUDE.md rule 14 and the 06 checklist. bun run typecheck fails on a clean checkout: src/router.tsx imports ./routeTree.gen, which is not committed and cannot be generated because src/routes does not exist. oxlint --deny-warnings reports 3 errors. Separately, the tempod client stores each event row before its handler runs and swallows handler errors, so a failed event (for example credential.changed when the CredentialDO RPC fails) is acked and never applied again, and a rotated Codex auth.json is lost. Container start, the DirectoryBackup and Files calls, the egress rules, the owner checks, secret handling and the state transitions match the spec and the real SDK and runtime types. Note: in this worktree, bun run typecheck and bun run test resolve node_modules from the main checkout, which has a newer @tempo/protocol, so I re-ran tsc against the worktree's own packages; only the routeTree.gen error is real.

findings.text: No tests are added. There is no test directory, no *.test.ts file and no vitest config, yet the change adds about 40 WorkspaceDO RPC methods, about 20 op steps, the egress rules, auth, the setup flow and crypto. CLAUDE.md rule 14 and the 06 checklist require a test for every server function, op step and tempod request, including one failure case each.

evidence.why: The test script has nothing to run: git diff --name-only shows no test files in this change, and apps/tempo has no vitest.config.ts, so the required DO tests with @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers are missing. Running bun run test in this environment also fails at startup (that run used the main checkout's node_modules, so I don't rely on its error).

findings.text: Typecheck fails on a clean checkout. The generated route tree is imported but not committed, and there is no src/routes directory to generate it from. tsc reports TS2307 even when resolved against the worktree's own packages, so CLAUDE.md rule 15 (bun run typecheck passes) is not met.

evidence.why: tsc output: src/router.tsx(4,27): error TS2307: Cannot find module './routeTree.gen'. The file is not in the commit, is not gitignored (only routeTree.gen.ts.bak is), and src/routes does not exist.

findings.text: Lint fails: oxlint --deny-warnings apps/tempo reports 3 errors. They are the unused ItemSchema import here, no-control-regex at rpc.ts:57 (BRANCH_RE) and no-useless-fallback-in-spread at runner.ts:306. CLAUDE.md rule 15 requires bun run lint to pass.

evidence.why: oxlint: core.ts:6:11 error eslint(no-unused-vars): Identifier 'ItemSchema' is imported but never used. The root lint script runs with --deny-warnings, so the lint step fails.

findings.text: If an event handler fails, the event is lost for good. The (incarnation, seq) row is inserted before onEvent runs, and the chain's catch only logs the error. The next event calls markApplied with a higher seq and acks it, so tempod drops the failed event from its outbox. On replay the existing row makes applyEvent return early. Concrete case: credential.changed runs await core.credentials().offerCodexAuth(...). If that cross-DO RPC fails transiently, the rotated Codex auth.json is never stored in CredentialDO, and its row in events holds only '{}', so it cannot be replayed. Other lease holders keep a stale refresh token. This breaks rule 5 (every step checks state before it acts) and the fail-closed requirement for errors.

evidence.why: applyEvent inserts the events row ('if (inserted.length === 0) return;') before 'await this.onEvent(event, envelope);'. A throw from onEvent is swallowed here and markApplied is skipped for that seq only. The next event acks past it, and a redelivered copy is dropped as a duplicate. Per 01, tempod resends credential.changed only when the auth.json hash changes again.

findings.text: If WorkspaceDO.init fails after the D1 insert (an RPC error or the isolate dying), the D1 row stays in state 'creating' with no DO behind it. It keeps holding the partial unique index on (project_id, branch) and slug, so creating a workspace from the same branch later returns BRANCH_IN_USE. The spec (03) does not say what to do, so this is not blocking; a test of the init-failure path would confirm the behavior.

init commits the workspace row in one transactionSync, then inserts the create op outside it. A crash between the two leaves a workspace that init treats as already done: a retry returns the existing summary and nothing re-inserts the create op, so the workspace stays in 'creating'. Not blocking.

container.snapshot calls snapshotContainer before it inserts the row. If the DO restarts in between, recovery reruns the step and creates a second snapshot; the first is never recorded or cleaned up. Not blocking.

fetch(new Request(request, { headers })) keeps the incoming request's redirect mode. I could not confirm whether the Workers runtime strips the injected GitHub Authorization header when GitHub redirects to another host, for example objects.githubusercontent.com. A probe in workerd would settle it. Not blocking.
ownerCache keeps true and false answers per isolate with no expiry, so a change to TEMPO_OWNER_GITHUB_ID or to an account row takes effect only after the isolate restarts. Not blocking.
